summary: Default-lane CLI-spawn cases declare a per-case budget from one home instead of inheriting vitest's 5s default

per.section: The default test lane must stay fast

acceptance: Every default-lane suite that spawns a CLI/node entry point declares the shared budget; the number lives once, in `tests/helpers/subprocess.ts`, cited at the spec section.
tests: every default-lane suite that spawns the CLI declares the shared spawn budget rather than inheriting the runner's default
notes: Note from WRITABLE-PATHS-GATE-NAMES-ITS-VIOLATING-PATHS: `cliHelp.test.ts` timed out at 5000ms under full-suite load, passed alone. Verified wider than reported — zero declared budgets anywhere in the tree, ~240 spawn sites across 12 default-lane suites, and no `testTimeout` in `vitest.config.ts`. A raised runner default is still inheriting one; the spec says declare per case. Twelve copies of the number would be the restatement defect, hence one home.
